comment: Patches for perl 5.36: originally auto-generated skip_codegen entries (tools/build-error-to-vpatches.pl); entries whose root cause has been identified are replaced by targeted overrides (see each reason). Re-run the tool after each perl-headers update or libperl-macrogen change.

patches.name: CopLINE
patches.source_loc: perl-5.34/5.36 cop.h (=for apidoc Am|STRLEN|CopLINE|const COP * c)
patches.reason: The =for apidoc annotation (added in the 5.34 cycle) mis-declares the return type as STRLEN, but the macro reads (c)->cop_line whose type is line_t (U32). The scraped header entry wins over body inference, so the generated fn was `-> STRLEN` with a U32 body (E0308). Fixing the dict entry also fixes CopLINE_inc/CopLINE_dec, whose return types are inferred from CopLINE (they have no apidoc annotation of their own). Replaces the former skip_codegen entries for CopLINE/CopLINE_dec/CopLINE_inc. <=5.32 has no annotation (pure inference, correct); 5.38 corrected the annotation to line_t upstream.
